title: Chair Model
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the employees of Dunder Mifflin face parking difficulties due to construction at W.B. Jones, causing frustration. Michael becomes fixated on a chair catalog model named Deborah Shoshlefski, only to learn she has died in a car accident. Seeking to move on from his past relationship, Michael asks coworkers to suggest women for him to date, leading to awkward encounters and humorous attempts at matchmaking. Meanwhile, Pam and Jim discuss their relationship with hints of a future proposal, and the office navigates the ongoing parking dispute.
